skills.name: Summoner's Ritual
lines: Stack 2 Dragon Origins on user and Attack all enemies with damage based on Spirit (upper limit: 70, Max Damage: 10,000) (ignores target's defense)
* Restores all Statuses on user, give Status immunity to user (1 time) and Restore 30 MP
* Dragon Origin: MP Consumption of skills reduced based on number of orbs stacked (max stack: 4)
* Extra Spirit gained/reduced from battle doesn't change this skill damage
** (Example: Yipha AS Faith or Milsha AS Sacrifice lunatic song)

skills.name: Twin Dragons
lines: Earth type piercing attack on a single enemy x2 (XL)
* Power of skill increases when used consecutively (Max 4 times, Multiplier x3)
** Skill Multiplier 300% -> 400% -> 600%
** Name changes to True → Ultra → Epic
* When not in Another Force: +200% damage (Multiplier x3)
* If Dragon Origin stack on user is at least 1, Fixed damage on all enemies based on user's SPR stat (upper limit: 400, Max Damage: 1,800,000) (ignores defense)
** Increases fixed damage when used consecutively (Max 4 times, Max Damage: 4,800,000)
*** Max Damage further increases based on number of Dragon Origin stacked (Max Stack 4, Max Damage: 24,000,000)
** Extra Spirit gained/reduced from battle doesn't change this skill fixed damage
*** (Example: Yipha AS Faith or Milsha AS Sacrifice lunatic song)
